apps.localizedDescription:
Available for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux and native HarmonyOS. Local reading needs no AI account; online tools are optional.

Features:

A flexible library, comfortable typography, scan-to-text reading, AI, translation, listening and sync. Keep your everyday reading tools close to the page.

PDFs and scanned books:

Keep the original layout while removing empty margins. Panel reading, rotation, zoom and image enhancement help you see the details on smaller screens.

On-device OCR:

Turn scanned pages into text you can reflow, select, translate and annotate. Lightweight OCR models run locally and work offline after download.

Original and reflowed text:

Read the original page alongside adjustable text. Stack them in portrait or place them side by side in landscape to check the source without losing your place.

versions.localizedDescription:
Modu 1.3.8:

Build / 构建：10175 · Stable / 正式版.

English:

• Fix(tts): Apply local speed control to OpenAI-compatible speech; support independent pitch on Android and macOS.
• Feat(notes): Search excerpts, comments and chapter names across all notes or within the current book.
• Fix(bookshelf): Keep folder cover density consistent across phone layouts.
• Feat(ocr): Add PP-OCRv6 Small as the default and Medium as a higher-accuracy option, retain v5, and provide Gitee model mirrors.
• Feat(dictionary): Add a copy button beneath each dictionary result.
• Fix(reader): Limit brightness adjustments to book content and content dialogs; keep menus and non-reading pages at system brightness in both themes.
• Feat(reader): Set header and footer fonts, colours and opacity independently, with reset controls.
• Feat(plugins): Preview plugin packages before installation and preserve registered dictionary, toolbar and reading actions. () Thanks @1Cookie2gavh.
• Fix(appearance): Refresh linked reading colours after palette, system brightness and scheduled theme changes; fix the fine-tune dialog layout. () Thanks @1Cookie2gavh.

Downloads:

Android ARM64 · iOS ARM64 · macOS ARM64 / x64 · Windows ARM64 / x64 · Linux x64 / ARM64 · HarmonyOS ARM64.
